title: 扇出型面板級封裝
summary: 以 12 個技術單元、24 步分析與驗證深入大面積均勻性、面板變形與拼接對位。逐一建立剖面、測試見證、失效判別和可審查的驗收證據。
summaryEn: Twelve technical units and 24 analysis/verification steps explore large-area uniformity, panel distortion and stitching, building sections, test witnesses, failure discrimination and reviewable acceptance evidence.
scope: 公開工程原理與原創教學推理；數值是明示假設的算例，不是生產配方或供應商規格。各單元先建立物理模型，再設計能區分失效機制的量測。24 步是學習工作包，完整量產需經授權設備、材料及產品資格驗證。
scopeEn: Public engineering principles and original educational reasoning. Numbers are explicitly hypothetical examples, not production recipes or supplier specifications. Each unit builds a physical model then measurements that discriminate failure mechanisms. The 24 steps are learning work packages; production requires qualified equipment, materials and product validation.

stages.title: 面板布局
stages.description: 針對面板布局完成三個專屬技術單元；每個單元包含物理分析與量測診斷兩步。
stages.descriptionEn: Three dedicated units for panel layout, each with physical analysis and measurement diagnosis.

steps.title: 格式與設備邊界｜機制與設計
steps.titleEn: Format and tool boundaries | mechanism and design
steps.objective: 針對格式與設備邊界，把「面板尺寸須同曝光、鍍膜、搬運和檢測設備相容。」轉成可驗證的工程判定，明確列出適用範圍與未知量。
steps.objectiveEn: For format and tool boundaries, turn "Panel size must fit patterning, deposition, handling and inspection." into a testable engineering decision with explicit bounds and unknowns.
steps.instruction: 本步先建立「格式與設備邊界」的模型：面板尺寸須同曝光、鍍膜、搬運和檢測設備相容。 在剖面或資料表中標出控制量、受影響量和交接介面；提出一組只改一項條件的比較，寫出預測方向。用「建立所有站點有效處理面積表。」規劃模型將如何被推翻；不要把畫得合理當作已經實測。
steps.instructionEn: Build the model for format and tool boundaries: Panel size must fit patterning, deposition, handling and inspection. Mark controlled quantities, responses and handoff interfaces in a section or data table. Compare two cases changing one condition and predict direction. Use this evidence plan: List effective process areas at every station. State how the model could be falsified; a plausible drawing is not a measurement.
steps.observation: 建立所有站點有效處理面積表。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
steps.observationEn: List effective process areas at every station. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
steps.failure: 避免：單一設備可容納就代表整線可用。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
steps.failureEn: Avoid: Equating one tool's capacity with line compatibility. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
steps.check: 交付格式與設備邊界的剖面或因果圖、兩組條件比較及一項可否定預測的量測；標出單位、基準與前後站接口。
steps.checkEn: Submit a section/causal diagram for format and tool boundaries, a two-case comparison and one falsifying measurement; include units, datums and upstream/downstream interfaces.

knowledge.title: 格式與設備邊界：機制
knowledge.text: 面板尺寸須同曝光、鍍膜、搬運和檢測設備相容。
knowledge.textEn: Panel size must fit patterning, deposition, handling and inspection.

knowledge.title: 量測與錯判分辨
knowledge.text: 建立所有站點有效處理面積表。 必須排除的錯判：單一設備可容納就代表整線可用。量測解析度、重複性與系統偏差分別列示；不同方法看到的範圍不可默認相同。
knowledge.textEn: List effective process areas at every station. Misinterpretation to reject: Equating one tool's capacity with line compatibility. Report resolution, repeatability and systematic bias separately; different methods do not automatically cover the same domain.

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜遊戲交班延伸：先界定介面
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Campaign transfer: define interfaces first
knowledge.text:
本課「扇出型面板級封裝」的「格式與設備邊界｜機制與設計」是這項延伸任務的檢核點。 畫出晶粒、基板、接點與量測端的介面，在每條箭頭旁寫量、單位、正方向與資料版本。再打開「接合線：失蹤的良率」，比較哪一個介面可類比、哪一個不可類比；不可因為畫面相似就共用數值參數。

需留下的證據：提交一張介面圖與批號、接合位置、熱歷史、接點讀值與顯微圖版本的欄位樣本；將假設值、來源值與本次實測值分欄。

驗證與交接：每個介面至少有一個可核對量；提出一項能讓模型失效的邊界改變，而不是只重述公式。
knowledge.textEn:
The checkpoint is “Format and tool boundaries | mechanism and design” in “Fan-out panel-level packaging”. Draw the die, substrate, joint and measurement interfaces; label quantities, units, sign conventions and data revisions on each arrow. Open “The Bonding Line: Lost Yield” and identify which interfaces transfer and which do not. Similar-looking scenes do not justify shared numerical parameters.

Evidence to retain: Submit an interface diagram and sample fields for lot, joint location, thermal history, contact readings and micrograph version, separating assumed, sourced and newly measured values.

Verification and handover: Each interface has a checkable quantity. Identify one boundary change that invalidates the model instead of merely repeating a formula.

quiz.question: 在「格式與設備邊界」的機制與設計中，哪一項判斷或行動有充分依據？
quiz.questionEn: For format and tool boundaries — mechanism and design — which decision or action is justified?
options: 面板尺寸須同曝光、鍍膜、搬運和檢測設備相容。
單一設備可容納就代表整線可用
只採樣中心即可代表面板
optionsEn: Panel size must fit patterning, deposition, handling and inspection.
Equating one tool's capacity with line compatibility
Sampling only the center to represent a panel
quiz.explanation: 面板尺寸須同曝光、鍍膜、搬運和檢測設備相容。 建立所有站點有效處理面積表。 因此不能採用「單一設備可容納就代表整線可用」。
quiz.explanationEn: Panel size must fit patterning, deposition, handling and inspection. List effective process areas at every station. Therefore reject: Equating one tool's capacity with line compatibility.

steps.title: 格式與設備邊界｜證據與診斷
steps.titleEn: Format and tool boundaries | evidence and diagnosis
steps.objective: 針對格式與設備邊界，把「面板尺寸須同曝光、鍍膜、搬運和檢測設備相容。」轉成可驗證的工程判定，明確列出適用範圍與未知量。
steps.objectiveEn: For format and tool boundaries, turn "Panel size must fit patterning, deposition, handling and inspection." into a testable engineering decision with explicit bounds and unknowns.
steps.instruction: 以先前模型進行證據審查：建立所有站點有效處理面積表。 將「單一設備可容納就代表整線可用」當作待否定假說，另提出一項可能造成相同表象的混淆因素。安排對照樣本、座標和重複量測，分開記錄觀察值與機制推論；指出哪個結果會讓你暫停放行。
steps.instructionEn: Review the preceding model with evidence: List effective process areas at every station. Challenge the hypothesis "Equating one tool's capacity with line compatibility" and name another mechanism that could give the same appearance. Plan controls, sampling coordinates and repeated measurements; separate observations from inference and identify a hold condition.
steps.observation: 建立所有站點有效處理面積表。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
steps.observationEn: List effective process areas at every station. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
steps.failure: 避免：單一設備可容納就代表整線可用。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
steps.failureEn: Avoid: Equating one tool's capacity with line compatibility. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
steps.check: 交付格式與設備邊界的證據表：原始觀察、兩個競爭假說、對照方法、不確定度與接受／暫緩條件；至少一項證據須獨立於主要讀值。
steps.checkEn: Submit evidence for format and tool boundaries: observations, two competing hypotheses, controls, uncertainty and accept/hold criteria, including one observation independent of the main reading.

steps.title: 邊緣與利用率｜機制與設計
steps.titleEn: Edges and utilization | mechanism and design
steps.objective: 針對邊緣與利用率，把「邊緣排除、街道和測試區降低幾何利用率。」轉成可驗證的工程判定，明確列出適用範圍與未知量。
steps.objectiveEn: For edges and utilization, turn "Edge exclusions, streets and test zones reduce utilization." into a testable engineering decision with explicit bounds and unknowns.
steps.instruction: 本步先建立「邊緣與利用率」的模型：邊緣排除、街道和測試區降低幾何利用率。 在剖面或資料表中標出控制量、受影響量和交接介面；提出一組只改一項條件的比較，寫出預測方向。用「用實際格點配置計數而非只除面積。」規劃模型將如何被推翻；不要把畫得合理當作已經實測。
steps.instructionEn: Build the model for edges and utilization: Edge exclusions, streets and test zones reduce utilization. Mark controlled quantities, responses and handoff interfaces in a section or data table. Compare two cases changing one condition and predict direction. Use this evidence plan: Count grid placements rather than divide area alone. State how the model could be falsified; a plausible drawing is not a measurement.
steps.observation: 用實際格點配置計數而非只除面積。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
steps.observationEn: Count grid placements rather than divide area alone. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
steps.failure: 避免：總面積除單位面積就是實際產量。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
steps.failureEn: Avoid: Using area division as actual output. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.

options: 總面積除單位面積就是實際產量
每場內 DRC 通過便無拼接問題

Assuming within-field DRC excludes stitching defects

steps.objective: 針對晶粒分布，把「不均勻晶粒密度使模封流動和剛性有方向性。」轉成可驗證的工程判定，明確列出適用範圍與未知量。
steps.objectiveEn: For die distribution, turn "Uneven die density makes mold flow and stiffness directional." into a testable engineering decision with explicit bounds and unknowns.
steps.instruction: 以先前模型進行證據審查：比較中央、邊緣與角落配置。 將「相同平均密度即可消除局部差異」當作待否定假說，另提出一項可能造成相同表象的混淆因素。安排對照樣本、座標和重複量測，分開記錄觀察值與機制推論；指出哪個結果會讓你暫停放行。
steps.instructionEn: Review the preceding model with evidence: Compare central, edge and corner layouts. Challenge the hypothesis "Assuming equal mean density removes local differences" and name another mechanism that could give the same appearance. Plan controls, sampling coordinates and repeated measurements; separate observations from inference and identify a hold condition.
steps.observation: 比較中央、邊緣與角落配置。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
steps.observationEn: Compare central, edge and corner layouts. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
steps.failure: 避免：相同平均密度即可消除局部差異。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
steps.failureEn: Avoid: Assuming equal mean density removes local differences. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
steps.check: 交付晶粒分布的證據表：原始觀察、兩個競爭假說、對照方法、不確定度與接受／暫緩條件；至少一項證據須獨立於主要讀值。
steps.checkEn: Submit evidence for die distribution: observations, two competing hypotheses, controls, uncertainty and accept/hold criteria, including one observation independent of the main reading.

knowledge.title: 晶粒分布：機制
knowledge.text: 不均勻晶粒密度使模封流動和剛性有方向性。
knowledge.textEn: Uneven die density makes mold flow and stiffness directional.

knowledge.title: 量測與錯判分辨
knowledge.text: 比較中央、邊緣與角落配置。 必須排除的錯判：相同平均密度即可消除局部差異。量測解析度、重複性與系統偏差分別列示；不同方法看到的範圍不可默認相同。
knowledge.textEn: Compare central, edge and corner layouts. Misinterpretation to reject: Assuming equal mean density removes local differences. Report resolution, repeatability and systematic bias separately; different methods do not automatically cover the same domain.

quiz.question: 在「晶粒分布」的證據與診斷中，哪一項判斷或行動有充分依據？
quiz.questionEn: For die distribution — evidence and diagnosis — which decision or action is justified?
options: 相同平均密度即可消除局部差異
平均鍍厚符合即可忽略邊緣薄區
比較中央、邊緣與角落配置。
optionsEn: Assuming equal mean density removes local differences
Ignoring thin edges after mean thickness passes
Compare central, edge and corner layouts.
quiz.explanation: 不均勻晶粒密度使模封流動和剛性有方向性。 比較中央、邊緣與角落配置。 因此不能採用「相同平均密度即可消除局部差異」。
quiz.explanationEn: Uneven die density makes mold flow and stiffness directional. Compare central, edge and corner layouts. Therefore reject: Assuming equal mean density removes local differences.
